status_semantics: Statuses describe acceptance evidence only: not_started means no valid acceptance result is recorded, passing means the recorded acceptance commands passed, and failing means the recorded acceptance commands failed. Task, environment, or prerequisite blockers are never stored here; current task execution, progress, decisions, and discoveries belong to an active ExecPlan. Later unrelated repository changes do not silently rewrite historical acceptance.

features.title: 项目初始化
features.acceptance_intent: A clean checkout can install dependencies, create local configuration, migrate the database, start both applications, and run the test harness.

features.title: 实体 CRUD API
features.acceptance_intent: Entities support validated create, read, update, delete, and search behavior while stable IDs and relationship references are protected.

features.title: 关系 CRUD API
features.acceptance_intent: Relationships support validated CRUD with valid endpoints, no self loops or silent duplicates, and consistent visibility markers.

features.title: 三视角过滤图查询
features.acceptance_intent: Author, character, and audience graph views expose only the entities and relationships allowed by their visibility rules without persisting view-specific copies.

features.title: 前端图谱工作台
features.acceptance_intent: Creators can inspect and edit the world model through an interactive force-directed graph and detail forms.

features.title: 视角切换 UI
features.acceptance_intent: Creators can switch author, character, and audience views and the graph refreshes using the selected perspective.

features.title: @ 实体选择器
features.acceptance_intent: Typing @ can search and insert stable entity references while showing whether each result is visible in the current graph view.

features.title: 资产管理
features.acceptance_intent: Creators can maintain reusable reference assets and project entity assets, upload safe images, and view self-contained HTML asset pages.

features.title: Agent 对话与确认写入
features.acceptance_intent: A project-scoped assistant can hold persistent conversations, retrieve only perspective-visible context, propose structured changes, and write only after user confirmation.

features.title: 多项目底座
features.acceptance_intent: Creators can create, switch, rename, and delete isolated projects while global reference assets remain shared.

features.title: 工作台导航与资产页重构
features.acceptance_intent: Project and general assets have stable routes, searchable library views, useful empty states, and non-destructive modal editing.

features.title: Agent 对话体验升级
features.acceptance_intent: Assistant responses stream content and reasoning, expose token usage, preserve conversation lifecycle, and allow safe session and memory-document management.

features.title: Agent 写入工具链
features.acceptance_intent: Assistant write tools create pending operations, present one end-of-turn confirmation, and apply only selected operations after server-side revalidation.

features.title: 长期记忆体系
features.acceptance_intent: Provide distinct guide and work documents, transparent editable project-scoped preferences, and source-backed cross-session recall.

features.title: 多系列剧情线
features.acceptance_intent: A project can contain multiple series that share a world-model base while filtering series-specific entities, documents, assets, and assistant context.

features.title: Artifact Core
features.acceptance_intent: A screenplay uses stable blocks and immutable revisions so one block edit produces a local diff and stales only dependent artifacts sourced from that block.

features.title: Narrative State Core
features.acceptance_intent: Ordered timepoints and append-only events produce traceable current state and immutable snapshots, while author claims remain separate from temporal character and audience knowledge.

features.title: Workflow Core
features.acceptance_intent: Versioned project requirements feed an isolated series/episode/scene-plan hierarchy, deterministic gates report unmet prerequisites, and mock creative runs retain an ordered audit without canonical writes.

features.title: Production Documents
features.acceptance_intent: Episodes move through the six ordered production documents with structured semantic blocks and traceable immediate-upstream dependencies; local source edits stale matching downstream without overwriting it.

features.title: Atomic Skills
features.acceptance_intent: Bounded skill contracts enforce minimal permitted context, deterministic gates and validators, audited impact previews, and durable explicit accept/reject before any declared canonical write.
